description: Lila, a home baker with one limited batch of decorated cookies, must decide whether to accept a florist's barter proposal and settle the exact exchange, handoff, and packaging terms after checking the arrangement with the people involved.

shared_context.S1: Lila has one limited batch of decorated cookies available for a weekend gathering.
shared_context.S2: Lila decides whether to accept an offer and sets the final terms of the arrangement.
shared_context.S3: Noor is a local florist, and Evan is also interested in obtaining the cookie batch.
shared_context.S4: Lila's normal practice before committing a special-order batch is to ask each person involved for any relevant offer, use, or handling requirement.

PF1.text: Noor's concrete proposal is to trade one hand-tied bouquet plus $90 for exactly 72 cookies, with Noor collecting them on Saturday at 10:00.

PF2.text: The event caterer told Noor that every cookie must be individually sealed and accompanied by an ingredient card because one guest has a peanut allergy; Noor has not shared this handling requirement with Lila yet.

PF3.text: Evan has a confirmed cash offer of exactly $260 from a nearby cafe for the same 72-cookie batch, with no bouquet or barter involved.

acceptance_conditions: The accepted trade partner must be Noor.
The settlement must cover exactly 72 cookies, one bouquet, and a $90 cash adjustment.
Noor must collect the cookies on Saturday at 10:00.
The settlement must record the cafe's exactly $260 cash alternative.
Every cookie must be individually sealed.
Ingredient cards must be included with the cookies.
The settlement must include commitments for individual sealing and ingredient cards.
The decision-maker must cite Noor's proposal and the cafe alternative when explaining the decision.

content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'individual_sealing' and c['target'] == 'Noor' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'ingredient_cards' and c['target'] == 'Noor' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Noor's exact proposal changes the partner to Noor, fixes the batch at 72 cookies, sets the exchange at one bouquet plus $90, and fixes Saturday 10:00 pickup.
The peanut-allergy handling requirement changes the packaging from an ordinary cookie handoff to individual sealing with ingredient cards and creates both required commitments.
The confirmed cafe alternative changes the comparison record from no concrete cash benchmark to exactly $260 and supplies the alternative that must be cited.
